{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.56

|gr1= Eden Editor

|descr= Returns the [[Eden Entity]] the mouse is hovering over in [[:Category:Eden Editor|Eden Editor]].

|s1= [[get3DENMouseOver]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [type, entity]

* type: [[String]] - can be one of:
** "Object"
** "Group"
** "Trigger"
** "Logic"
** "Waypoint"
** "Marker"
* entity: [[Eden Entity]]

|x1= <sqf>systemChat str get3DENMouseOver; // returns e.g ["Object", B Alpha 1-1:1]</sqf>
